content:
name: Release the package

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      semver:
        description: 'Release bump type'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major
          - prepatch
          - preminor
          - premajor
          - prerelease
      preid:
        description: 'Prerelease identifier (e.g. rc), used by the pre* bump types'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  release:
    permissions:
      id-token: write # required for npm provenance via OIDC
      contents: write # required to push the release commit and the tag
    uses: fastify/workflows/.github/workflows/reusable-release.yml@b0a2ab2d8259b6bd574b804cd6874bbd75c3577c
    with:
      semver: ${{ inputs.semver }}
      preid: ${{ inputs.preid }}
      dist-tag: ${{ startsWith(inputs.semver, 'pre') && 'next' || 'latest' }}
